answer: The most convincing defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New entrants like opal cannot grade until vetted; each task randomly samples a jetty of senior graders, and reputation stake is slashed for collusion, so sybil identities earn nothing and risk their owners' accumulated standing. An attacker spinning up a spiral of fake personas pays ongoing entry costs plus slashing risk, making forgery strictly unprofitable.
